notes: «جماعة مشايخي» is an unnamed group of teachers (rule 8), co-transmitter of «أبي» in the same level
«أبي» is named only by relation to the compiler (rule 7)
«سمعت أبا بصير يقول قال أبو عبد الله» : the Imam is named in the words after the chain: imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
The Imam's father speaks and acts in the scene (Hisham's summons): not a link; whether that in-scene Imam is a source is held for ruling (rule 11)
